title: Policy Priorities & Climate Report
goal: Frame executive-summary priorities with neuter lo + adjective/participle and read a C1 climate-policy report.

items: I can frame policy priorities with neuter *lo* + formal adjectives and past participles (*lo prioritario, lo acordado*).
I can use plural verb agreement when *lo* + adjective links to a plural predicate noun (*Lo más urgente son...*).
I can follow a climate-policy report on grid electrification, carbon pricing, ecosystems and governance.
